description: Bizuayeu's two-Spark Sage-S2.1-Flash Mixed NVFP4 recipe: the stock TensorFold 1.3.2 release (no fork, no patches) at TP=2 over the direct RoCE link, serving the creator's mixed checkpoint (routed experts NVFP4, MLA attention and shared experts the official FP8 bytes, KDA attention, head and vision tower BF16) with vision and thinking on, a 262,144-token window for one request at a time (the creator's most complete verified launch: vision, tool calls, images up to 2,016 pixels, a 200,000-token prompt), 4 kept prompt states (TF_KV_SHARE 4) and an 11 GiB reserve that the creator found necessary once image input is on. The creator publishes no image: the image installs the checksummed release archive on NVIDIA's CUDA 13.0 base, and Controller placement supplies rank, rendezvous and RoCE rails. Memory is very tight: the creator measured 93.90 GiB of model on the first machine and 9.63 GiB free at the lowest on a pair of Sparks (the declared peak is the 121.69 GiB total less that), all estimates until tried here. Upstream figures (19.9 tok/s decode with drafts off, 6.7 s to the first token of a cold 9,600-token prompt, KL 0.0426 and 93.56% top-1 agreement against BF16) are the creator's, not measured here; the creator measured this launch (262,144-token window, vision on) on TensorFold main build 077998f7d9 and it is being tried here on release 1.3.2, which contains that build; the creator's card verified release 1.2.9 with only a 40,960-token window with vision off.
title: Sage S2.1 Flash Mixed NVFP4 TensorFold dual Spark (Bizuayeu)
